response.rationale: A and B look like the same scale device seen from two layers. ScaleRepository (node 18ab235f6c31a91a, src/persistence/repositories.ts) holds Scale entities: "private readonly items = new Map<string, Scale>();". ScaleService (node f7e458262ae72ac4, src/business/scaleService.ts) creates a scale record with "return this.scales.save({ serialNumber, hiveId, ownerId, phoneNumber });". The graph shows this call goes to ScaleRepository.save, and that ScaleService receives ScaleRepository through its constructor. So the "Hive Scale" that ScaleService saves, tied to a hive, is stored as the same Scale entity that ScaleRepository keeps. The two names point to one real-world thing (a scale linked to a hive and found by serial number), not just two concepts that share fields.
